drivingQuestion: Why is the clause about first tithe without teruma not obvious?
outcomeNote: the clause is justified against Rav Pappa's view

segments.he: מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא כְּדַאֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב פָּפָּא לְאַבָּיֵי. קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן כִּדְשַׁנִּי לֵיהּ.
segments.en: «Lest you say» the halakha in that case is «as Rav Pappa said to Abaye,» and the Levite is exempt from separating teruma gedola, and therefore the food may be used for an eiruv, the mishna «teaches us as» Abaye «responded to» Rav Pappa: If the Levite takes grain after it had been gathered in a pile, he must separate teruma gedola. Until he does so the produce may not be eaten.
